use default

divisor_count(n: int) -> int =>
    (1::n) |> filter(divisor => n % divisor == 0) |> count()

anti_primes() -> Pipe[int] is
    let most mut = 0
    let n mut = 1

    do
        let divisors = divisor_count(n)

        if divisors > most then
            most = divisors

            yield n
        fi

        n = n + 1
    od
